preview: A free AI pet may sound easy to try, but would you want to make time for one in a busy day? In this episode, we look at what might make adults want to spend time with an AI pet.
comment_1: Listen for what the app listings say about who can use this AI pet.
comment_2: The app is free, but its store descriptions say users must be 18 or older. So what do the different age labels mean?
comment_3: So far, we know the app is free, but its age information can be confusing. As you listen next, pay attention to what else you may want to consider before trying it.
comment_4: This story is not only about a free app. It asks whether adults have room for an AI pet in a busy day, while the app’s future is still unclear. Now, let’s bring the main idea together.
